hazards.description: The existing sidewalk on the right is directly adjacent to the curb with no physical separation from high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The large parking lot and metal fence create a lack of 'eyes on the street,' which can decrease perceived safety and comfort for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation and Curbing
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the right side of the street with a raised curb to separate pedestrians from the roadway and gas station apron.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the gas station access points to defined driveways, minimizing the conflict area between turning vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island to break up the long crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Install Continuous Sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk along the property frontage to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the roadway and the new sidewalk to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing and Definition
interventions.description: Redesign the gas station entrance to be narrower and more clearly defined, using curbs or bollards to separate the pedestrian path from the vehicle path.

interventions.title: Street Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the transverse crosswalk markings to high-visibility continental or ladder patterns.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes or narrow existing lanes to slow traffic and provide space for better pedestrian or cycling infrastructure.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Mid-Block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated and safer crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and uneven concrete to provide a safe, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Construct Protected Sidewalks
interventions.description: Install a raised sidewalk with a curb along the perimeter to provide physical separation between pedestrians and vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Surface Remediation
interventions.description: Repair or replace the cracked and uneven pavement to provide a stable and safe walking surface.

interventions.title: Delineated Pedestrian Paths
interventions.description: Use high-visibility paint and signage to mark clear pedestrian paths and vehicle travel lanes within the lot to organize movement.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk across the gas station frontage to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Use pavement markings or physical buffers to narrow travel lanes, which can help reduce vehicle speeds and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk with RRFB
interventions.description: Implement a high-visibility marked crosswalk equipped with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to alert drivers.

interventions.title: Raised Sidewalk and Curbing
interventions.description: Construct a standard raised sidewalk with a vertical curb to provide physical separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Consolidated Driveways
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the vehicle access point to a standard driveway size, restoring the sidewalk and curb for the majority of the block.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk and Curbing
interventions.description: Install a continuous raised sidewalk with defined, narrowed driveway entrances across the gas station frontage to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island and high-visibility signage or a Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB).

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearing
interventions.description: Repair the sidewalk surface and implement regular debris removal to ensure a clear, accessible path.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Plant street trees or install a furniture zone to provide physical and psychological separation between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Infill
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to complete the pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip between the curb and the walking path to increase physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: On-Street Parking or Bike Lane
interventions.description: Repurpose a portion of the wide roadway for on-street parking or a protected bike lane to narrow the vehicle travel path and provide a barrier for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Enhanced Landscaping
interventions.description: Improve the perimeter of the parking lot with denser vegetation to soften the blank frontage and improve the microclimate.
